question: Should OpenClaw accept `includeFamily` as the public Gateway/tool/model-facing contract for opt-in reset-family transcript visibility, with `offset` rejected and archive reads bounded plus header-checked?
rationale: This changes what prior archived/reset transcript content a model-facing history call can request, so automation can verify mechanics but cannot choose the intended visibility and API boundary.

options.title: Accept `includeFamily` contract
options.body: Approve the current opt-in selector, bounded/header-checked archive reads, and `includeFamily` plus `offset` rejection as the mergeable session-history boundary.

options.title: Narrow the exposed surface
options.body: Ask for metadata-only older-history indication or a UI/export-only path instead of model-facing transcript inclusion.

options.title: Defer to broader archive design
options.body: Pause this PR and route the remaining work through the broader archived transcript/export recovery discussion.

recommendation.title: Accept `includeFamily` contract
recommendation.body: Approve the current opt-in selector, bounded/header-checked archive reads, and `includeFamily` plus `offset` rejection as the mergeable session-history boundary.
